models.name: Prompt Palette Syntax
models.summary: Ready-to-run examples for Prompt Palette choices, wildcard modifiers, multi-select, variables, comments, parameters, and combinatorial expansion.
models.format: Insert an example and preview it. Wildcard examples use a real My Library path automatically when one is available.

categories.name: Inline Choices
categories.description: Brace syntax for seeded, unseeded, sequential, weighted, and cycling choices.

prompts.title: Seeded random choice
prompts.prompt: Editorial portrait, {soft window light|late-afternoon backlight|clean studio light}, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: Plain braces pick one option. The same Prompt Palette seed reproduces the same result.

prompts.title: Unseeded random choice
prompts.prompt: Editorial portrait, {*soft window light|late-afternoon backlight|clean studio light}, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: The * modifier makes this choice independent of the Prompt Palette seed.

prompts.title: Sequential choice — next
prompts.prompt: Editorial portrait, {+soft daylight|warm tungsten|cool fluorescent}, clean background.
prompts.note: The + modifier advances through the options one step at a time.

prompts.title: Sequential choice — previous
prompts.prompt: Editorial portrait, {-soft daylight|warm tungsten|cool fluorescent}, clean background.
prompts.note: The - modifier walks backward through the options.

prompts.title: Weighted choice
prompts.prompt: Portrait framing, {5::tight close-up|2::medium portrait|1::full-body shot}, clean background.
prompts.note: Weights before :: make an option more or less likely while keeping the choice seeded.

prompts.title: Cartesian cycle
prompts.prompt: {%close portrait|full body|detail crop}, {%soft daylight|hard sun|tungsten practicals}.
prompts.note: The % modifier cycles through the Cartesian combinations across editor resolves.

categories.name: Wildcard Modifiers
categories.description: The same selection modes applied to files from your wildcard library.

prompts.title: Seeded wildcard
prompts.prompt: Full-body fashion portrait in __Locations/Location__, natural motion, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: Prompt Palette substitutes an available My Library path when possible. Plain __path__ is seeded.

prompts.title: Unseeded wildcard
prompts.prompt: Full-body fashion portrait in __*Locations/Location__, natural motion, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: * ignores the Prompt Palette seed and makes a fresh random wildcard pick.

prompts.title: Sequential wildcard — next
prompts.prompt: Full-body fashion portrait in __+Locations/Location__, natural motion, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: + advances to the next line in the wildcard file each time it resolves.

prompts.title: Sequential wildcard — previous
prompts.prompt: Full-body fashion portrait in __-Locations/Location__, natural motion, 70mm lens.
prompts.note: - walks backward through the wildcard file.

prompts.title: Cartesian wildcard cycle
prompts.prompt: __%Locations/Location__, {%morning|afternoon|night}, editorial photograph.
prompts.note: % groups advance through their Cartesian combinations across editor resolves.

categories.name: Multi-select & Joining
categories.description: Choose several options at once and control how they are joined.

prompts.title: Pick exactly two
prompts.prompt: Accessories: {2$$, $$gold chain|silver ring|leather watch|black sunglasses}.
prompts.note: 2$$joiner$$ chooses exactly two unique slots and joins them with comma + space.

prompts.title: Pick one to three
prompts.prompt: Atmosphere: {1-3$$ + $$rim light|fog|lens flare|practical glow}.
prompts.note: 1-3 chooses a seeded count in the range, then joins the selected options with the text between $$ markers.

prompts.title: Wildcard multi-pick slots
prompts.prompt: Palette: {2$$, $$4#__Locations/Location__}.
prompts.note: N# duplicates a token into option slots before multi-select. Prompt Palette substitutes an available My Library path when possible.

categories.name: Prompt Variables
categories.description: Define reusable text once, resolve it immediately when needed, or provide a default.

prompts.title: Define and reuse
prompts.prompt:
${subject=handsome man}
Editorial portrait of ${subject}; ${subject} reflected in a shop window.
prompts.note: The assignment is removed from output. ${subject} reuses its stored expression wherever it appears.

prompts.title: Resolve once, reuse result
prompts.prompt:
${light=!{soft window light|hard side light|warm practical light}}
Portrait in ${light}; background reflections echo the same ${light}.
prompts.note: =! resolves the expression when assigned, so every later use gets the exact same picked value.

prompts.title: Variable with default
prompts.prompt: ${wardrobe:tailored black suit}, editorial portrait, clean studio backdrop.
prompts.note: If wardrobe has not been assigned, the text after : is resolved as its fallback value.

categories.name: Workflow Syntax
categories.description: Comments, parameterized wildcards, and full combinatorial generation.

prompts.title: Comment line
prompts.prompt:
# Notes can live in the editor without reaching the final prompt.
Editorial portrait, clean natural light, 85mm lens.
prompts.note: A line whose first non-space character is # is removed before resolution.

prompts.title: Parameterized wildcard call
prompts.prompt: __Templates/Portrait(subject=handsome man,light=warm tungsten)__
prompts.note: A parameterized wildcard can use ${subject} and ${light} inside its own wildcard file. Replace the path with your template entry.

prompts.title: Combinatorial matrix
prompts.prompt: {close portrait|full body} in {soft daylight|warm tungsten}, {35mm|85mm} lens.
prompts.note: In Prompt Palette Combinatorial, unmodified braces expand to every unique combination. In the editor, the same text resolves to one seeded prompt.

prompts.title: Wildcard × choice matrix
prompts.prompt: __Locations/Location__, {morning|afternoon|night}, editorial photograph.
prompts.note: In Prompt Palette Combinatorial, an unmodified wildcard expands every line and combines it with each brace option, up to the node limit.
